        "contents": "@import '../config/variables';\n\n@mixin viewport-min($viewport-width) {\n  @media (min-width: $viewport-width) {\n    @content;\n  }\n}\n\n\n@mixin flex-item-input() {\n  width: 5rem;\n\n  border-bottom: 2px dashed transparent;\n  background-color: transparent;\n  outline: 0;\n\n  color: $pink-3;\n  text-align: center;\n  font-size: 2.5rem;\n  font-size: calc(12px + (34 - 12) * ((100vw - 300px) / (1600 - 300)));\n  font-weight: 400;\n\n}\n\n@mixin input-number() {\n  -moz-appearance: textfield;\n  &amp;::-webkit-outer-spin-button,\n  &amp;::-webkit-inner-spin-button {\n    -webkit-appearance: none;\n    margin: 0;\n  }\n}\n\n@mixin flex-item-button() {\n  align-items: center;\n  width: 1rem;\n  height: 1rem;\n  position: relative;\n  left: 0;\n  top: 0;\n}\n\n\n@mixin flex-item-increment() {\n  background-image: url('../img/increment-button.svg');\n  background-repeat: no-repeat;\n  background-position: center;\n}\n\n@mixin flex-item-decrement() {\n  background-image: url('../img/decrement-button.svg');\n  background-repeat: no-repeat;\n  background-position: center;\n}\n\n@mixin flex-item-flexulations-container() {\n  font-size: calc(12px + (22 - 12) * ((100vw - 300px) / (1600 - 300)));\n  font-weight: 400;\n  letter-spacing: -.09rem;\n}",

If this &lt;b&gt;total flex basis&lt;/b&gt; is &lt;b&gt;greater&lt;/b&gt; than the parent container, each flex-item will have to reduce it's size to fit.&lt;p class=\"example-formula__description\"style=\"padding: 1rem 0 0 0;\"&gt;The flex-shrink attribute determines how much space is &lt;b&gt;given up&lt;/b&gt; by the flex-item. Unlike &lt;b&gt;flex-grow&lt;/b&gt;, the &lt;b&gt;flex-shrink&lt;/b&gt; value controls how much space is given up. Increasing the &lt;b&gt;flex-shrink&lt;/b&gt; will reduce the size of the flex-item relative to its siblings.&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-container\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-section\"&gt;&lt;header class=\"example-formula__formula-header\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-number\"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;1&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-container\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-title\"&gt;Flex Container Remaining Space&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-details\"&gt;Add up each flex item's &lt;b&gt;flex basis&lt;/b&gt; Sum all &lt;b&gt;item shrink basis total&lt;/b&gt; values to get the &lt;b&gt;shrink basis total&lt;/b&gt;. Divide these two to get the &lt;b&gt;shrink factor&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/header&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-statement\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;(Item Shrink * Item Basis) = Item Shrink Basis Total &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value\"&gt;(&lt;span class=\"shrink-example__item-shrink\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;/&lt;span class=\"shrink-example__item-basis\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;) &lt;span class=\"shrink-example__item-shrink-sum\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operator\"&gt;/&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;Shrink Basis Total &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value shrink-example__shrink-basis-total\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operator\"&gt;=&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;Shrink Factor &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value shrink-example__shrink-factor\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-section\"&gt;&lt;header class=\"example-formula__formula-header\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-number\"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;3&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-container\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-title\"&gt;Allocated Shrink Amount&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-details\"&gt;Multiply the &lt;b&gt;shrink factor&lt;/b&gt; against the &lt;b&gt;remaining space&lt;/b&gt; to finally get the amount to reduce from the item.&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/header&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-statement\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;Shrink Factor &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value shrink-example__shrink-factor\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operator\"&gt;*&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;Remaining Space &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value shrink-example__remaining-space\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operator\"&gt;=&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;Shrink Amount &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value shrink-example__shrink-amount\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-section\"&gt;&lt;header class=\"example-formula__formula-header\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-number\"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;4&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-container\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-title\"&gt;Compute Final Width&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-details\"&gt;Reduce the &lt;b&gt;item basis&lt;/b&gt; class=\"example-formula__description\"&gt;Take all the sizes from the flex items and add them up. If this &lt;b&gt;total flex basis&lt;/b&gt; is &lt;b&gt;greater&lt;/b&gt; than the parent container, each flex-item will have to reduce it's size to fit.&lt;p class=\"example-formula__description\"style=\"padding: 1rem 0 0 0;\"&gt;The flex-shrink attribute determines how much space is &lt;b&gt;given up&lt;/b&gt; by the flex-item. Unlike &lt;b&gt;flex-grow&lt;/b&gt;, the &lt;b&gt;flex-shrink&lt;/b&gt; value controls how much space is given up. Increasing the &lt;b&gt;flex-shrink&lt;/b&gt; will reduce the size of the flex-item relative to its siblings.&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-container\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-section\"&gt;&lt;header class=\"example-formula__formula-header\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-number\"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;1&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-container\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-title\"&gt;Flex Container Remaining Space&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-details\"&gt;Add up each flex item's &lt;b&gt;flex basis&lt;/b&gt; to get the &lt;b&gt;total flex basis&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/header&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-statement\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;Container Width &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value shrink-example__container\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operator\"&gt;-&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;Total Basis &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value shrink-example__total-flex-basis\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operator\"&gt;=&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__section-formula-operand\"&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-property\"&gt;Remaining Space &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=\"example-formula__section-formula-value shrink-example__remaining-space\"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-section\"&gt;&lt;header class=\"example-formula__formula-header\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-number\"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;2&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-container\"&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-title\"&gt;Calculate Shrink Factor&lt;/section&gt;&lt;section class=\"example-formula__formula-header-details\"&gt;Multiple each items' shrink value by it's basis to get the &lt;b&gt;item shrink basis total&lt;/b&gt;.
